notes: V36 (CR 601.2f, 601.2h: unpayable costs can't be paid): with an empty hand, the Sparkhunter Masticore exiled by Idol of Endurance cannot be cast, because its additional cost (discard a card) cannot be paid. The 'you may cast' offer narrows to skip, so the Masticore stays in exile; the Idol's activation still resolves (it taps).
